# Ozzy's Equipment Hire

> Melbourne-based hire of LED trailers, VMS trailers and mobile billboard trailers across Victoria, Australia.

## Services
- LED trailer hire for events, festivals, sport and corporate activations
- VMS (variable message sign) trailer hire for traffic management and roadworks
- Mobile billboard trailer hire for outdoor advertising and campaigns

## Service area
Melbourne CBD, Greater Melbourne suburbs, Geelong, Ballarat, Bendigo, Gippsland and regional Victoria.
